name: OmniDisplay
author: Charles Gameti
description: Every display setting in one bar widget: drag-and-drop arrangement, resolution, refresh, scale, rotation, mirroring, HDR and colour, adaptive sync, brightness (backlight and DDC/CI), auto-switching profiles, workspace planning, Miracast/AirPlay casting and tablet screens, with every change kept only after you confirm it.

barWidget.description: Arrange displays, change modes, scale, rotation, colour and brightness, switch profiles, cast and use a tablet as a screen

schema.label: Text beside the icon
schema.description: How many displays are on, the active profile's name, or what a cast is doing. Vertical bars stay icon-only.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: compact is 480 px, comfortable 600 px and wide 720 px. The panel never grows past the screen.

schema.label: Seconds to keep a change
schema.description: Every change goes live first. Without Keep in this time, the previous settings come back on their own.

schema.label: Where kept settings go
schema.description: block+service writes one managed block at the end of monitors.lua. state-file writes the same to a file in Omarchy's toggles folder and never edits monitors.lua. Both carry every profile, so Hyprland applies the right one from boot. service-only writes no file: profiles are restored once the shell runs.

schema.label: Switch profiles automatically
schema.description: When displays are plugged in or out, or Hyprland reloads, the profile kept for that set of displays is applied again.

schema.label: monitors.lua backups to keep
schema.description: A copy is taken before every save. They can be restored from the Profiles tab.

schema.label: Snapping distance
schema.description: In logical pixels: how close a dragged display must land to snap to a neighbour's start, centre or end.

schema.label: Identify displays when the panel opens
schema.description: Shows each screen's number for a moment, matching the tiles.

schema.label: External monitor brightness (DDC/CI)
schema.description: Uses ddcutil, when installed, for brightness, contrast and input source on external monitors.

schema.label: Show the Colour tab
schema.description: HDR, colour presets, bit depth and SDR controls.

schema.label: Show the Cast tab
schema.description: Miracast and AirPlay casting, and tablets as screens.

schema.label: Presentation mode while casting or mirroring
schema.description: Keeps the screen awake and notifications quiet while a cast streams or the laptop mirrors, and puts both back afterwards.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: A note when an unknown set of displays is connected, and when the watchdog reverted a change.

schema.label: Per-terminal font sizes
schema.description: Adds a font size row per installed terminal under Text size.
